hints: You only care about the *most recent* time a reading was seen. Why is an older sighting never the better one?
Because if an older sighting is within reach then the newer one is too. So one position per distinct reading is all you need.
Walk the log once, keeping a map from reading to the position where you last saw it, and check the gap before you overwrite it.
The same thing falls out of a window: keep a set of the last k readings, and look the current one up in it before adding it.
